en: A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a rural inn (Gasthof) beside a pond with swans. Large leafy trees line the water, and a long, light-colored building with a red roof stands in the background. In the foreground, a couple of figures are by the pond's edge. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed German text appears at the bottom, including a greeting from Göppersdorf in the Dresden district and a printer's credit from Meissen.
